title: Egredere ab occidente (Liber secundus quatuor et viginiti musicales) (Conseil)
desc: Jean Conseil, Egredere ab occidente (Liber secundus quatuor et viginiti musicales). 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Liber secundus quatuor et viginiti musicales. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
